comments.python:.embody/envoy-bridge.py: Not a dev script. Embody's STDIO<->HTTP bridge to the Envoy MCP server inside TD; regenerated on every Envoy start and launched by the MCP client. Hidden because running it by hand does nothing useful.
comments.python:.embody/tdn_textconv.py: Not a dev script. The git textconv driver that strips volatile header churn from .tdn diffs; git invokes it during diff/log/show. Hidden because it only makes sense with a file argument from git.
comments.python:packaging/upload.py: The ONLY shell-side script in this repo's release flow (step 4 of packaging/README). Syncs packaging/publish/ to the R2 bucket via wrangler, setting Cache-Control per file: release-pinned objects immutable, the rolling manifest.json no-cache. Already-uploaded pinned objects are skipped, so re-running after a flaky connection touches only what failed. Needs wrangler installed and authenticated, and a staged packaging/publish/ (Stage() runs inside TD). Run the --dry variant first. Everything else in packaging/ -- build_manifest, publish, release_one, build_installer, install -- runs INSIDE TouchDesigner and is not launchable from here.
comments.python:scripts/publish_public.py: Generates the PUBLIC mirror (function-store/FunctionStore_tools, checkout in ../FNSTools_PUB) from ONE COMMIT of this private repo -- never the dirty working tree, so commit first. Withholds every .toe, the sources of gated packages (derived from catalog.json access), and the declared private paths; refuses to run while a gated package is root-carried. Dry run is the default and prints every exclusion with the rule behind it; nothing is written without --push. The website is deployed by Vercel from the mirror, so a docs or site change reaches functionstore.tools only after this has run. The pre-push hook refuses a direct git push to the public remote; this script is the only sanctioned way in.

variants.name: packaging/upload.py --dry
variants.comment: Prints the upload plan and uploads nothing. Run this before the real sync to see which objects are new.

variants.name: packaging/upload.py --force
variants.comment: Re-uploads objects that already exist in the bucket. Only for repairing a truncated or corrupted upload -- normal publishes never need it, since pinned objects are immutable.

variants.name: scripts/publish_public.py --only website
variants.comment: Dry run of the website-only mirror: shows what the `website` preset would publish (website/, packaging/docs/, packaging/configurator/, icons/, catalog.json, manifest.json, parameters.json) and every exclusion. Writes nothing.

variants.name: scripts/publish_public.py --only website --push
variants.comment: THE way to ship the site: mirrors only the website's inputs from HEAD into the public checkout, commits there and pushes, which triggers the Vercel deploy. The rest of the mirror is left untouched, so tool work still landing in this repo does not ride along with a docs pass. Commit here first: it reads HEAD, not the working tree.
